summary.plain: The collaboration that built and ran the High Resolution Spectrometer at PEP; its authors came from US universities and national laboratories including Michigan, Argonne, Indiana and Purdue.
summary.technical: HRS Collaboration at PEP. The 1990 four-lepton paper (Phys. Rev. D 42, 2180) lists authors at Michigan, Argonne, Indiana, Purdue, Illinois, Wisconsin, Ohio State, Kansas, Cornell, Virginia Tech, LBL, SLAC and Fermilab and others (Stony Brook research-portal record of the paper).
